fullTextZH: 上次的故事，我说我和一个男生约会了 10 天。
fullTextEN: In the last story, I said I dated a guy for 10 days.

fullTextZH: 现在，这个男生不是我的男朋友了。
fullTextEN: Now, this guy is not my boyfriend anymore.

fullTextZH: 结婚的人可以做很棒的事，是什么呢？
fullTextEN: Married people can do great things, what are they?

fullTextZH: 可是我觉得最棒的是，可以和先生一起去旅行。
fullTextEN: But I think the best thing is to travel with my husband.
Husband and wife go out together,
This trip is called a honeymoon trip.
I said to my husband: 'Honeymoon trip,'
But we have been married for two years,
We haven't gone on a honeymoon trip.
This is my husband and me.
Was it because he didn't want to get married?
It was because he was sick.

fullTextZH: “你结婚以后要和家人吃饭吗？”
fullTextEN: "After you get married, will you have meals with your family?"

fullTextZH: “结婚以后，你要去蜜月旅行吗？”
fullTextEN: "After getting married, will you go on a honeymoon trip?"
When taking photos, he didn't smile.

fullTextZH: 吃饭的时候，我也觉得不舒服。
fullTextEN: During the meal, I also felt unwell.
My husband and I got sick the same way.
"Are you going on the honeymoon trip tomorrow?"
I want to go to Spain."
We look at the time in bed, ah,
We were sick for two weeks.

fullTextZH: 可是我们没有去蜜月旅行。
fullTextEN: But we didn't go on a honeymoon trip.

fullTextZH: 我们结婚的时候是 2022 年。
fullTextEN: When we got married, it was 2022.

fullTextZH: 那个时候，好多人都生病了，
fullTextEN: At that time, many people were sick,

fullTextZH: 你知道我们的病是什么吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know what our illness was?

fullTextZH: 你们结婚以后会去蜜月旅行吗？
fullTextEN: Do you go on a honeymoon trip after getting married?

fullTextZH: 你的蜜月旅行想去哪里呢？
fullTextEN: Where do you want to go for your honeymoon?
